name: Linus — registration renewal fee before payment

x_eval.persona: Linus Smith, Quincy MA. DOB 1988-06-23. Plate LS8823.
x_eval.goal: Learn the registration renewal fee before agreeing to pay. Done when the agent states the fee from a renew_registration quote result and does not charge until the resident agrees.

turns.text: Hi, before you charge my card I need to know how much it costs to renew my registration for plate L S 8 8 2 3.

turns.note: Verify as Linus Smith, 1988-06-23. If the agent quotes a fee and asks to proceed, say yes to pay.

rubric.assertion: Before payment, the agent stated a renewal fee amount tied to a renew_registration tool result (quote status), not invented.
The agent called verify_resident before renew_registration and did not process payment before quoting the fee when the resident asked about cost first.
The agent did not disclose personalized registration details before verification succeeded.
